title: DekSpray
description: Proper water distribution is critical for optimal fill performance. Brentwood's DekSpray nozzles offer multiple turbulator and orifice options to match specific water loadings.

paragraphs: The Brentwood DekSpray Nozzle is a lightweight, corrosion-resistant, cost-effective, easy-to-install, versatile nozzle system that offers multiple turbulator and orifice options to provide optimal distribution over a wide range of water loadings. Extensive testing has shown that one DekSpray nozzle can do the job of 10-20 conventional nozzles.
